about: Walkthrough queue: iOS apps in the refero.design catalog with no systems/ package. Apps carry no domain, so coverage is matched by name against package slugs — the `covered` list is reference, spot-check before claiming. One measured package per app; refero styles are landing-page design only and never substitute.
method: extract-style skill + tools/kit/ native iOS capture through iPhone Mirroring (docs/CAPTURE.md), then the systems/<slug>/ layout in docs/PACKAGE.md with evidence labels and a catalog.json entry in the same change.
agent_notes: Dismiss popups and system prompts yourself: App Tracking Transparency, notification/contacts/photos permission sheets, cookie and consent banners, onboarding carousels, rating prompts. Never hand a dismissable dialog back to the user.

Sign in yourself: prefer Sign in with Apple or "Continue with Google" already configured on the capture device/profile, and complete it without asking. For email signup use a disposable test account and record it in the package notes.

Escalate only real blockers: SMS/phone verification, paid or region-locked apps, org SSO or invite gates, hardware keys, TestFlight-only builds. Set status to "blocked" with the reason in notes instead of deferring silently.
Capture functionality, not just design: walk onboarding and the core flows (first run, main tabs/screens, settings, key actions). A web marketing page of the same product is not iOS app evidence.
One app per PR: when it merges set status to "captured" and package to the systems/<slug>. Keep this manifest in the commit.
